patterns.visual_hook: Immediate screen motion or a visual convergence moment.
patterns.opening_hook: Stop scrolling. Start seeing the signal.
patterns.verbal_hook: Stop scrolling. Start seeing the signal.
patterns.emotional_trigger: Curiosity mixed with relief from noisy research.
patterns.pain_point: Conflicting opinions and too many tabs to validate a trade.
patterns.desire: A faster, more transparent way to see what informed traders are watching.
patterns.fear: Missing context and reacting to the loudest opinion.
patterns.curiosity_gap: What changes when scattered viewpoints are compared together?
patterns.icp: Active self-directed stock, index, and crypto traders.
patterns.promise: Turn market noise into a clearer research starting point.
patterns.mechanism: Aggregate and compare trader viewpoints with explicit context.
patterns.proof: Use dated, source-labeled examples instead of unsupported performance claims.
patterns.credibility: Transparent source mix and a visible research workflow.
patterns.objection_handling: A consensus signal is a research input, not a guarantee; manage risk independently.
patterns.narrative_structure: interrupt → amplify noise → reveal mechanism → clarify next step
patterns.visual_style: high-contrast fintech UI, kinetic type, chart motion
patterns.pacing: fast first beat, deliberate reveal, concise close
patterns.editing_style: hard cuts, split screens, data particles, clean end card
patterns.captions: Short captions with one idea per beat.
pattern_interrupts: all opinions collapse into one card
patterns.social_proof: Use aggregate viewpoints only when the source and date are visible.
patterns.urgency: Timeliness comes from the dated research context, not fake countdowns.
patterns.offer_structure: Show the workflow, then invite the viewer to explore CrowdWisdom.

evidence.claim: Demo creative pattern only; no performance success is asserted.
